description: This line plot illustrates the evolution of Word Error Rate (WER) over six epochs for four different Whisper fine-tuning configurations, all categorized under the type = small. The x-axis represents the epoch, ranging from 0 to 6 on a linear scale, with tick labels at integer intervals. The y-axis represents WER, ranging from 25.0 to 42.5 on a linear scale, with tick labels spaced at 2.5-unit intervals. The plot contains four distinct lines: the “small AdaLoRA_int4” model is represented by a solid orange line with circle markers, starting at a WER of 35.0 at epoch 0 and decreasing to 30.0 at epoch 6; the “small AdaLoRA_int8” model is shown as a dashed orange line with circle markers, beginning at 35.0 at epoch 0 and ending at 25.0 at epoch 6; the “small int8” model is depicted by a solid orange line with square markers, starting at 30.0 at epoch 0 and declining to 25.0 at epoch 6; and the “small AdaLoRA_int8” model is represented by a dashed orange line with circle markers, starting at 35.0 at epoch 0 and ending at 30.0 at epoch 6.
